newsitem.title: USA: CPI Corp refinances senior debt.
newsitem.headline: CPI Corp refinances senior debt.

text.p: CPI Corp, a consumer services company, said Monday it has completed the private placement of $60 million in senior notes with Prudential Insurance Co of America and The Guardian Life Insurance Co of America.
Proceeds of the financing will be used to refinance existing senior notes and for general corporate purposes, the company said.
The average effective rate is 7.46 percent and the notes mature in 10 years, CPI said.
Certain covenants of the new debt are less restrictive than covenants associated with the prior senior notes, the company said.
Also, the company said it has entered into a new $40 million revolving line of credit with three banks.
CPI also said it has seen sales increases of about 10 percent over the past six or seven weeks at its Sears Portrait Studios.
CPI shares closed down 1/8 at 18-3/4 Monday.
